News
Research
July 2026
Real-time EMG testing with Karl and the PSYONIC Ability Hand
In July 2026, I had the opportunity to work with Karl in a real-time research session testing our EMG control models with the PSYONIC Ability Hand. Karl, who has a congenital bilateral upper-limb difference, offered valuable hands-on feedback that helped us better understand how the system performs in practice and how it can be improved to support more natural and reliable prosthetic hand control.
Research
July 2026
Data collection with Paralympic swimmer Katarina
It was an honour to meet and speak with Paralympic swimmer Katarina during a July 2026 data collection session for our prosthetic hand research. Alongside the research session itself, hearing about her experiences and perspective was truly inspiring and a meaningful reminder of the people at the centre of this work.
Talk
August 2024
Talk at OPC National Conference 2024 — Fredericton, NB
Presented "Exploring Training Strategies for Enhanced Myoelectric Control in Prosthetic Hands" at the Orthotics & Prosthetics Canada annual conference. Addressed a multidisciplinary clinical and engineering audience of prosthetists, OTs, and rehabilitation engineers.
Talk
2024
Talk at Alberta Robotics & Intelligent Systems Expo (RISE) 2024
Presented research on semi-autonomous prosthetic hand control using imitation learning from the contralateral limb to an audience of robotics and AI researchers.
